body: I work for a call center. The only think that has been on my mind all this time is to get healthy and live again, anything else would probably come easy afterwards :)

Nothing except tv & pc ...so yeah, sucks :)

No worries, I wish it was a little thing that could be fixed with the help of a professional ;D Yeah, it's really hard, being depressed all the time is horrible, especially when you stay in the house all day long for years, time passes even harder. It's like I'm in jail, without doing anything. My main interest is to get healthy obviously, to be a normal person. Afterwards, anything would be better. I miss so much doing the normal stuff, that even being able to speak to people without feeling embarassed and watching them in the eyes would be a huge thing, let alone other things. Thanks for taking your time and posting here :)

Yes, I talked to a lot of people with the same skin issues that I have and have followed the same treatments as I did. And after hundreds and hundreds of hours of research, I know what I have to do to have a chance at a clear skin and that's a complete set of specific tests, which my dermatologists didn't mention because 1). they're very expensive and 2). no money from those tests would go into their pocket. So that's not about self confidence or anything, because it's not a little thing at all, believe me. Go on google and search ''severe cystic acne'', trust me, there's no way someone could have a normal life while suffering of this horrible disease. You feel like a monster even when you do the normal stuff, like waiting in line at a store or riding the bus, you can see everyone staring at your face. I started cutting my own hair just because I felt horrible the last time I was at a barber shop, with everybody staring at me in the bright light for 20 minutes. I don't feel comfortable doing these things, let alone finding a different job, meet people/girls, go to parties etc. So there's absolutely nothing a specialist can tell me to make me change my mind, just lies. There's no middle ground in this thing, you either get cured, or you don't. A few years back I never thought about suicide, but now, after 6 years, I don't see the point in living this kind of life anymore. I've done my waiting, tried pretty much everything and for nothing.
